create.title: Create workspace
create.importHint: Bring a workspace export in, with its history
create.name: Workspace name

empty.title: You're not in a workspace yet
empty.createHint: Create one with + in the sidebar, or ask someone to invite you.
empty.inviteHint: Once someone invites you to one, it shows up here.

guest.accessEnded: Your guest access to {{workspace}} has ended.
guest.accessEndedUnnamed: Your guest access to a workspace has ended.
guest.untilHint: On that day they leave the workspace. Admins hear of it three days before.
guest.saveFailed: Could not change the guest access
guest.endingSoon: Only guests whose access ends in the next 30 days
guest.noneEnding: No guest's access ends in the next 30 days.

inviteRequest.explain: Only admins invite people to this workspace. Send them a request and they decide.
inviteRequest.emailsHint: Separate them with commas or new lines. Up to {{max}} at once.
inviteRequest.tooMany: At most {{max}} addresses in one request.
inviteRequest.sent: Request sent. You'll hear in Activity when an admin answers.
inviteRequest.editDescription: Change who is invited or on what terms, then send the invites.
inviteRequest.declineDescription: They hear of it in Activity, with your note if you write one.

profileFields.explain: Fields every profile in this workspace has, such as a department, a manager or an office. Each person fills in their own; admins fill in the ones marked admins only.
profileFields.label: Label
profileFields.hintPlaceholder: Shown under the field when someone fills it in
profileFields.kindFixed: A field keeps its kind once it exists.
profileFields.optionsRemoved: Removing an option clears it from every profile that picked it.
profileFields.adminsOnlyHint: Everyone sees it, but only an admin can fill it in, as for an employee number.
profileFields.onCardHint: At most two fields show when someone hovers over a name.
profileFields.cardFull: Two fields already show on the hover card.
profileFields.reorderHint: Drag a field to change the order profiles show them in, or focus its handle and use the arrow keys.
profileFields.deleteDescription_zero: It is removed from every profile. Nobody has filled it in yet.
profileFields.deleteDescription_one: It is removed from every profile, with the {{count}} value filled in.
profileFields.deleteDescription_other: It is removed from every profile, with the {{count}} values filled in.
